prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1308; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Witnesses and the officer say the claimant was not in the vehicle when the crash happened.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane and began a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through. Driver 2 stated that the collision happened as described, and two independent witnesses gave consistent accounts of the impact. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to both vehicles that matches the described collision, and I found no indication of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 later reported a concussion. However, both witnesses and I observed that Driver 1 was not inside the vehicle at the moment of the crash, so the reported position of Driver 1 requires follow-up. Whether the reported injury resulted from this collision is not yet established. A Passenger was not identified at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle. Further statements and medical information will be requested before any conclusions are drawn.
